name: wpf-restore
description: Sub-recipe: restore the WPF counter fixture window and check the frame button flipped back.
notes: Sub-recipe: the counterpart to wpf-minimize, and the way back from an iconic window when a step needs coordinates, a screenshot or foreground delivery (none of which work while minimized). The check is the frame button's label: 'Restore' while iconic, 'Minimize' while restored. Not idempotent in the same way as its twin - running it on an already-restored window fails with `no Button "Restore"`, so it is a move, not a state assertion; use a check on the window itself when the question is 'is it iconic?'.
